messages:
Alyssa (CSM): Hey team — I'm putting together a short customer-facing runbook for prefetch, batching, and streaming to hand to customers during onboarding and at renewal check-ins. Goal: 1 page + pasteable config + a few renewal risk flags. Can someone own sections?
Mike (Enablement): I can draft the one-pager. Suggest structure: 1) Quick explainers (what prefetch/batch/stream solve) 2) Default config for low-latency apps 3) Troubleshooting + handoff checklist.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): I’ll add a small, copy-paste config and a short example for SDK usage. Keep the config conservative so it’s safe for first deploy.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): ```yaml
# customer starter profile - safe defaults
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 150
  max_prefetch_tokens: 256
  strategy: conservative
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 8
  max_tokens_per_request: 1024
streaming:
  enabled: true
  chunk_ms: 75
  fallback_to_non_streaming_after_ms: 5000
# notes: adjust window_ms up for high throughput customers, lower for strict latency
```
Priya (Renewals): Add a short list of renewal risk signals we can surface to account owners: 1) sustained >20% drop in tokens served week-over-week 2) >=3 quality regressions on eval prompt set in last 30 days 3) repeated rate-limit errors or >5% 429s 4) customers disabling prefetch/batching because of surprising hallucination patterns.
Mike (Enablement): For the handoff checklist I recommend: - confirm model & quantization profile - set prefetch window & batch caps - run canary traffic for 24–48h - capture 3 eval prompts and baseline outputs - schedule a renewal check-in 30 days before term end. Keep it as a single-sheet checklist.
Alyssa (CSM): Perfect. Proposed owners: Mike = one-pager + checklist, Jordan = config examples + SDK snippet, Priya = renewal signals + short scripting for alerts. I’ll assemble and add an executive summary for customers (value & when to call us). Target publish: Friday EOD. :thumbsup:
Mike (Enablement): I’ll start a Google doc and paste the checklist. Suggest a short customer-friendly blurb: "Enable prefetch & batching to lower jitter and cost — we’ll help tune it."
oncall-bot: Note: Shared doc created by Mike. Link: https://docs.internal.example/CS-prefetch-starter (internal).
Alyssa (CSM): When doc is up, can we also export a one-slide PDF for renewal emails? Keep copy succinct — 3 bullets.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Yup. Also will include a tiny troubleshooting table: symptom -> likely cause -> quick fix (e.g., high latency -> prefetch window too large or batch too small). I’ll keep entries to 3 lines max.
Priya (Renewals): I’ll create a short snippet for the CRM renewal play: auto-add account to "at-risk" if any 2 signals fire, CS owner gets ping 14 days after trigger.
Alyssa (CSM): Great, thanks. If anyone finds customer examples we can anonymize and include as "before/after" tuning notes. That usually helps renewals.
Mike (Enablement): Will loop in design for the one-pager layout. Will post draft link by tomorrow morning.
Alyssa (CSM): Thanks everyone — assigning tasks in the doc now. We’ll review on Friday sync if needed. :white_check_mark:
